text: …　…　…　おお　そうか　わしが　よんだのじゃった！

structure.jp: わしが　よんだのじゃった！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ explains or stresses a fact; じゃ is the old-man form of だ, and じゃった is the past of it. わしが　よんだのじゃった = 'it was I who called you'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is an old-man or professor way to say だ. じゃった = 'was'.
